candidate.description: The absolute path of the staged candidate.

secret_hash.description: The hash of the secret the Gateway recorded, if any; a file that matches it is kept.

allow_secret_rotation.description: Direct convergence cannot rotate a secret owned by enrollment or explicit recovery.

checkouts.description: Application directories whose `.env` other local users must not read.

binary_changed.description: The binary changed just before, so the observer restarts.

unclosed.description: Checkouts whose environment could not be closed; the converge only warns about them.

create_missing.description: Create missing components; otherwise a missing component fails.

environment.description: The release's `.env`, which holds the app secrets.

purge.description: Also delete the install and its releases.

release.description: The release to install when the Node needs one; null when the Gateway has none to offer.

profile.description: Root's CLI profile, written when it differs.

installed.description: The version installed, or null when the Node keeps its CLI.

releases.description: The Ubuntu codenames the role supports.

composer_home.description: The shared Composer home of an application role. Its JavaScript runtimes come from the machine recipe.

user.description: The production user that owns the release.

home.description: The persistent production home with `current` and `releases`.

application.description: The application directory inside the selected release.

php_version.description: The selected PHP version, such as `8.5`. The command runs `php<version>`.

input.title: ActivateInput
input.description: The production home of an Instance and what each release in it must be.

relative_root.description: The Instance web root, relative to a release.

application_suffix.description: The application directory under a release, such as `/server/web`, or empty for the release itself.

ServedRoot.description: A Route web root that the Instance serves besides its own root, and the application directory under it.

markers.description: The content of each marker that exists, by kind, base64-encoded because it holds NUL separators.

releases.description: The origin of each release, or `None` when the release has no readable origin.

changes.description: Applied in order; the Gateway puts the release layout marker last, because deployment checks it first.

name.description: The release name for a `release` change.

max_bytes.description: The most bytes the answer holds, from the end of the log.

content.description: The file's content in base64, for a read.

State.description: One outcome, as the Python program printed it.

oneOf.description: A boundary check refused before anything changed.
The work failed; with `installed`, after the replacement was in place.

base.description: The checkout or production home that holds the file.

require_home.description: A production home must be the user's home.

managed_keys.description: The keys a merge owns in `.env.testing`.

content.description: The new content of a write, or the managed lines of a merge.
The file's content in base64, for a read.

State.description: One outcome, as the Python program printed it.

oneOf.description: A boundary check refused before anything changed.
The work failed; with `installed`, after the replacement was in place.
A path that escapes the checkout, a file that is not the user's, or a link where a file belongs.

owner.description: The account that must own `.env` and the cached configuration.

app_key.description: The `APP_KEY=` line a new file takes, or that fills an empty key.

app_key_stored.description: Whether the key is the Instance's stored one, which a new file takes over the template's.

require_artisan.description: Another application directory without `artisan` is left alone.

user.description: The managed account that owns the checkouts.

relative_root.description: The Web root, relative to the checkout.

unreadable.description: Served entries whose mode hides them from Caddy, at most 100 and a marker when there are more.

probe.description: Also ask the listener for the Vite client, and check ownership again after the answer.

oneOf.description: Removes the awake marker, so the Instance's traffic waits.
Creates the awake marker, readable by Caddy, in its root-owned directory.
Writes the environment file with the Vite port, after checks of the application, and suspends traffic.

content_base64.description: Encoding bounds the JSON result even when the file contains non-text bytes.

minimum_version.description: The oldest Caddy release Orbit renders against.

oneOf.description: The checkout is a plain Git checkout at `current`; with `git_read`, the proposed repository answers.
Writes the origin only when it differs, so a read-only checkout never blocks a rollback.

GitRead.description: The schema mirrors the hand-written deserializer below, which refuses unknown fields.

oneOf.description: Prepares the marker and access log directories, then creates the marker readable by Caddy.

times.description: Each path's modification time in Unix seconds, or null when it does not exist.

repository.description: The Instance's checkout, whose newest source file dates its last activity.

checkout.description: The application directory that holds the dependencies.

cascade.description: A cascade removes the Schedule while a run is active; a standalone removal waits for it.

name.description: The unit, such as `orbit-process-7-web.service`, or the container, such as `orbit-process-7-web`.

on_demand.description: An on-demand host starts the unit without enabling it, so it does not start at boot.

vite.description: A Vite+ dev Process also leaves the environment file of its Instance.

staged.description: A candidate waits for `process.activate-unit`; without one the unit already has this content.

previous.description: Whether the Process had a unit, which a publication replaces.

state.description: The unit's state when nothing was staged.

oneOf.description: Publish the candidate over the Process's unit, keeping a backup.
Publish the candidate where the Process had no unit.
The unit is published; reload systemd and set the desired state again.

backup_left.description: The backup of a replaced unit could not be deleted.

output.description:
A unit's entries newest first, cut after `max_bytes`; a container's last lines, of which the last
`max_bytes` stay.

checkout.description: Any Instance checkout of this account, by its canonical path.

environment.description: Variables the step sees beside the account's own, such as `VP_HOME` and the seed.

StepProgram.description: A Project shell command, or a built-in operation implemented in Rust.

oneOf.description: `@orbit/ci-caches`: imports the Pint and PHPStan caches of the recorded code baseline.

timed_out.description: Whether the step's own bound stopped it.

output.description: The redacted output in the order it was written.

directory.description: The application directory relative to a release, or empty for the release itself.

app_key.description: The `APP_KEY=` line a new file without a key takes.

app_name.description: The `APP_NAME=` line a new file takes.

app_name_stored.description: Whether the name is the Instance's stored one, which replaces any template name.

application.description: The application directory under `current`, and the same under `releases/initial`.

oneOf.description: Publish the whole runtime, restarting the master when a file changed.
Publish only a monitoring change of the pool, with a reload. A runtime that does not exist is left alone.

Configuration.description: The configuration the Gateway renders for one runtime.

initial_pool.description: The pool for the first start, before `current` exists.

published.description: Whether the master restarted or started with new files.

deadline_seconds.description: How long the reset may take, from 1 to 30 seconds.

config.description: The rendered hub configuration, private key included.

public_key.description: The public key the running `orbit` interface must have.
